waits.words: The giant meteor crater itself: a sculpted crater form isn't a block Architect has yet. The mine and lair are built on the land as it is, and the crater is offered when it can be built.

answer.summary: A single mining settlement of eleven buildings along a street: an overseer's keep on high ground, a central mine head, a slag foundry, two ore crushers, four edge-set barracks, a brimstone shrine and an ore store. Its infernal style is made after this plan. The crater itself isn't buildable yet and is held as a pending part; a relief pass blends the land around the buildings meanwhile.
